history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re only exploring for now—could you tell me what kind of home it is?

It’s a 900 sq. ft. home with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. That gives you a separate room you could use for work or guests, alongside the bedrooms. Are you exploring mainly for your own stay or as an investment?
For our own stay if we move. We’re just exploring for now and seeing whether another layout might suit us better.

That makes sense—layout can feel quite different for your own stay. This 900 sq. ft. plan avoids a long internal corridor, with an open living, dining and kitchen area and a small storage space, so it may be worth comparing for how the everyday space is used. What are you hoping the other layout does better?
A quieter corner for work and a bit more usable space in the shared area would be nice. Our current place is okay, though, so there’s no rush.

That makes sense, especially if your current place is working well. One of the three bedrooms could be used as a separate work corner, while the open-plan living, dining and kitchen area has no long internal corridor taking up space. A look in person could help you judge whether that shared area feels more usable for you—no need to rush; we can arrange a viewing whenever comparing layouts becomes useful.
I can see how that layout might help. I’d need to talk it over with my spouse first; since we’re not in a rush to move, I’m not ready to arrange a visit yet.

Of course—this is something to decide together, especially since your current place is working well. The separate bedroom for work and open-plan shared area may be useful points to compare with your spouse. No need to arrange a visit now; you can see together whether an in-person look would help later.
